verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party LibreChat statement, setting, or policy about keeping user data out of AI model training. Self-hosting and connecting local providers like Ollama are deployment building blocks, not a documented training-prevention capability. The community note that OpenAI does not train on API usage describes the model provider's policy, not LibreChat's.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
